summary: Unlock effective property leasing and rent collection strategies with our expert-led training course. Elevate your real estate management skills now!
lede: Property leasing and rent collection involve controlling rental income from lease setup through renewal or recovery. For professionals managing leases, tenants, rent ledgers or portfolio reports, the training covers building lease abstracts, validating rent rolls, and reconciling billing and receipts. Participants also practise analyzing arrears, planning tenant communications, and comparing financial options for renewal decisions using spreadsheets, dashboards and case files.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with leases, tenants, rent ledgers, property operations, or portfolio reporting and need stronger control over rental income performance.
modules: Lease Data and Rent Roll Controls
prerequisites: You should bring practical experience with property leasing, rent billing, lease administration, property accounting, or tenant management. No programming background is required. TrainingCred provides structured case data, lease templates, rent-roll exercises, and reporting worksheets; a laptop is recommended for spreadsheet and dashboard activities.
